jsonl_rows.route: Deferred-decision capped exploration and propagation across adjacent fibers
jsonl_rows.result: No infinite cluster has uniformly bounded fiber intersections when p_c(G)=1; any infinite fiber intersection propagates to every fiber. General finite-but-unbounded fiber sizes are not excluded.

jsonl_rows.route: Uniform cutset reduction and variable-cap extension
jsonl_rows.result: The known cutset theorem is strictly stronger: an exponentially stretched binary tree has p_c=1 but no uniform cutset bound. An inhomogeneous percolation on a ray demonstrates why edge bounds approaching 1 do not contradict homogeneous p_c=1. No original-target counterexample or full proof.
